cartridges.title_pt: Empacotamento Esférico em Alta Dimensão — Cota de Kabatiansky-Levenshtein
cartridges.summary: Asymptotic exponential upper bound on spherical codes and kissing numbers in R^n.
cartridges.example_prompt: Explain concisely what the Kabatiansky-Levenshtein theorem proves for high-dimensional unit spheres.
cartridges.teacher_reference: The Kabatiansky-Levenshtein theorem provides an upper bound on the number of non-overlapping unit spheres that can be packed into a high-dimensional space, specifically showing that the maximum number of such spheres grows exponentially with the dimension but at a rate slower

cartridges.title: Thermodynamics of Computation — Landauer's Principle (k_B T ln 2)
cartridges.title_pt: Termodinâmica da Computação — Princípio de Landauer (k_B T ln 2)
cartridges.summary: Minimum irreversible heat dissipation bound k_B T ln 2 per erased bit at temperature T.
cartridges.example_prompt: Explain concisely what Landauer's principle states for the minimum energy dissipated when erasing one bit at temperature T.
cartridges.teacher_reference: Landauer's principle states that the minimum energy dissipated when erasing one bit of information at temperature \( T \) is \( k_B T \ln 2 \), where \( k_B \) is the Boltzmann constant.

cartridges.title: Space Complexity — Immerman-Szelepcsényi Theorem (NSPACE = co-NSPACE)
cartridges.title_pt: Complexidade Espacial — Teorema de Immerman-Szelepcsényi (NSPACE = co-NSPACE)
cartridges.summary: Closure of nondeterministic space complexity classes under complementation via inductive counting.
cartridges.example_prompt: Explain concisely what the Immerman-Szelepcsenyi theorem proves about nondeterministic space complexity classes.
cartridges.teacher_reference: The Immerman-Szelepcsenyi theorem proves that nondeterministic space complexity classes are closed under complementation, specifically that NSPACE(s(n)) = co-NSPACE(s(n)) for any function s(n) ≥ log(n).

cartridges.title: Distributed Consensus — FLP Impossibility Theorem
cartridges.title_pt: Sistemas Distribuídos — Teorema da Impossibilidade FLP
cartridges.summary: Impossibility of deterministic fault-tolerant consensus in asynchronous message-passing systems with one crash.
cartridges.example_prompt: Explain concisely what the Fischer-Lynch-Paterson impossibility theorem proves about asynchronous consensus.
cartridges.teacher_reference: The Fischer-Lynch-Paterson (FLP) impossibility theorem proves that in an asynchronous distributed system, it is impossible to achieve deterministic consensus if even a single process may fail.

cartridges.title: Algorithmic Information Theory — Chaitin's Incompleteness Theorem
cartridges.title_pt: Teoria Algorítmica da Informação — Incompletude de Chaitin (Kolmogorov)
cartridges.summary: Upper bound L beyond which no formal axiomatic system can prove lower bounds K(x) > L on Kolmogorov complexity.
cartridges.example_prompt: Explain concisely what Chaitin's incompleteness theorem proves regarding Kolmogorov complexity.
cartridges.teacher_reference: Chaitin's incompleteness theorem proves that within any consistent formal axiomatic system, there is a constant L such that the system cannot prove the Kolmogorov complexity of any string exceeds L.

cartridges.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography — Regev's LWE Worst-Case Lattice Reduction
cartridges.title_pt: Criptografia Pós-Quântica — Redução Quântica LWE de Regev
cartridges.summary: Quantum worst-case to average-case reduction from GapSVP/SIVP lattice problems to Learning With Errors (LWE).
cartridges.example_prompt: Explain concisely what Oded Regev's theorem proves connecting Learning With Errors (LWE) to worst-case lattice problems.
cartridges.teacher_reference: Oded Regev proved that the hardness of the Learning With Errors (LWE) problem in its average case is at least as hard as certain worst-case lattice problems, specifically the shortest vector problem (SVP) and the closest vector problem (CVP).

cartridges.title: Random Matrix Theory — Marchenko-Pastur Spectral Distribution
cartridges.title_pt: Matrizes Aleatórias em IA — Lei Espectral de Marchenko-Pastur
cartridges.summary: Limiting eigenvalue density and compact support [(1 - sqrt(gamma))^2, (1 + sqrt(gamma))^2] of Wishart covariance matrices.
cartridges.example_prompt: Explain concisely what the Marchenko-Pastur law establishes for the eigenvalues of large random covariance matrices.
cartridges.teacher_reference: The Marchenko-Pastur law states that the limiting eigenvalue distribution of large random sample covariance matrices, as the dimensions grow proportionally, follows a specific distribution characterized by a continuous density function and a possible atom at the origin.

cartridges.title: Communications & Signal Theory — Shannon-Hartley Channel Capacity
cartridges.title_pt: Engenharia de Comunicações — Lei de Capacidade de Shannon-Hartley
cartridges.summary: Tight upper rate C = B log2(1 + S/N) for arbitrarily reliable communication over an AWGN channel.
cartridges.example_prompt: State concisely the Shannon-Hartley channel capacity formula and what it proves for noisy AWGN channels.
cartridges.teacher_reference: The Shannon-Hartley theorem establishes that the maximum error-free information capacity \( C \) over a noisy Additive White Gaussian Noise (AWGN) channel is given by \( C = B \log_2(1 + \frac{S}{N}) \)
